name: locations
description: Private location history explorer - Cloudflare Workers + Neon + Better Auth

scripts.dev:all: npm run build:web && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @locations/web" "npm run dev -w @locations/api"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @locations/web && npm run build -w @locations/api
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build:all && wrangler versions upload
scripts.auth:create-demo: npm run create-user -w @locations/db -- demo@locations.app demo1234 Demo demo
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck -w @locations/web && npm run typecheck -w @locations/api && npm run typecheck -w @locations/db
